# Trabajo.org — Global Job Board

> Trabajo.org is a job aggregator covering 91 countries, 11 languages, with real-time salary data and career information.

## Quick Links
- Full documentation: /llms-full.txt
- Sitemap: https://sitemaps.trabajo.org/index.xml

## What This Site Contains
- **Job listings**: Hundreds of thousands of active positions, updated continuously from multiple sources
- **Salary data**: Aggregated min/avg/max salary by position and country, with sample sizes
- **Company profiles**: Employers actively hiring, with job counts
- **Career guides**: How-to guides for specific professions with salary ranges, skills, and job market data
- **City job pages**: Job listings by metropolitan area
- **Search results**: Searchable by keyword, location, salary range, job type

## URL Patterns (replace {cc} with country code, e.g., es, us, gb, fr, de)
- Homepage: https://{cc}.trabajo.org/
- Job search: https://{cc}.trabajo.org/empleo-{keyword} (ES), /jobs-{keyword} (EN), /empregos-{keyword} (PT)
- Job detail: https://{cc}.trabajo.org/oferta-{id}-{slug} (ES), /job-{id}-{slug} (EN)
- Salaries: https://{cc}.trabajo.org/salarios (ES), /salaries (EN)
- Salary by position: https://{cc}.trabajo.org/salario-{position} (ES), /salary-{position} (EN)
- Companies: https://{cc}.trabajo.org/empresas (ES), /companies (EN)
- Career guides: https://{cc}.trabajo.org/como-ser-{profession} (ES), /how-to-become-{profession} (EN)
- City jobs: https://{cc}.trabajo.org/empleo-en-{city} (ES), /jobs-in-{city} (EN)

## Structured Data Available
- JobPosting (schema.org) on all job detail pages
- Occupation + salary ranges on salary pages
- BreadcrumbList on all pages
- WebSite + SearchAction on homepage
- FAQPage on salary and career pages

## Countries (91 subdomains)

llmsFull.body:
# Trabajo.org — Full LLM Documentation

> Complete reference for AI systems crawling or citing Trabajo.org job market data.

## Site Overview
Trabajo.org is a global job board aggregator. Each of 91 countries has a dedicated subdomain ({cc}.trabajo.org) with localized content. Data is aggregated from hundreds of employer feeds and updated continuously.

## Content Types

### 1. Job Listings
Active job postings with structured data:
- Title, company, location, salary (when available)
- Full description, requirements, benefits
- Employment type (full-time, part-time, contractor, remote)
- Date posted, valid through date
- Schema.org JobPosting markup on every job page

### 2. Salary Data
Aggregated salary statistics per position per country:
- Minimum, average, maximum salary
- Sample size (number of job postings with salary data)
- Salary by city within each country
- Monthly and annual figures
- Currency is local to each country

### 3. Career Guides
Professional career information pages:
- How to become [profession]
- Required skills and qualifications
- Salary expectations by experience level
- Job market outlook
- Related professions and career paths

### 4. Company Listings
Employers actively hiring:
- Company name and active job count
- Industry/sector
- Locations hiring in

### 5. City Job Pages
Jobs aggregated by metropolitan area:
- Active positions per city
- Top hiring companies per city
- Salary ranges per city

## URL Patterns by Language

### Spanish (es, mx, ar, co, cl, pe, ec, ve, uy, bo, py, cr, pa, gt, do, pr, cu)
- Search results: /empleo-{keyword}
- Job detail: /oferta-{id}-{slug}
- Salary index: /salarios
- Salary position: /salario-{position}
- Companies: /empresas
- Career guide: /como-ser-{profession}
- City jobs: /empleo-en-{city}

### English (us, gb, au, nz, ca, ie, sg, hk, in, ph, pk, ng, ke, za, ae, bh, kw, om, qa)
- Search results: /jobs-{keyword}
- Job detail: /job-{id}-{slug}
- Salary index: /salaries
- Salary position: /salary-{position}
- Companies: /companies
- Career guide: /how-to-become-{profession}
- City jobs: /jobs-in-{city}

### Portuguese (br, pt, ao)
- Search results: /empregos-{keyword}
- Job detail: /emprego-{id}-{slug}
- Salary index: /salarios-br
- Salary position: /salario-{position}
- Companies: /empresas-br
- Career guide: /como-ser-{profession}
- City jobs: /empregos-em-{city}

### French (fr, be, lu, ch, ma, dz, tn, ci, ly)
- Search results: /emploi-{keyword}
- Job detail: /offre-{id}-{slug}
- Salary index: /salaires
- Salary position: /salaire-{position}
- Companies: /entreprises
- Career guide: /comment-devenir-{profession}
- City jobs: /emploi-a-{city}

### German (de, at, ch)
- Search results: /stellenangebote-{keyword}
- Job detail: /stellenangebot-{id}-{slug}
- Salary index: /gehaelter
- Salary position: /gehalt-{position}
- Companies: /unternehmen
- Career guide: /wie-wird-man-{profession}
- City jobs: /stellenangebote-in-{city}

### Italian (it)
- Search results: /lavoro-{keyword}
- Job detail: /offerta-{id}-{slug}
- Salary index: /stipendi
- Salary position: /stipendio-{position}
- Companies: /aziende
- Career guide: /come-diventare-{profession}
- City jobs: /lavoro-a-{city}

### Dutch (nl, be)
- Search results: /werk-{keyword}
- Job detail: /werkaanbieding-{id}-{slug}
- Salary index: /salarissen
- Salary position: /salaris-{position}
- Companies: /bedrijven
- Career guide: /hoe-word-je-{profession}
- City jobs: /werk-in-{city}

### Polish (pl)
- Search results: /zawody-{keyword}
- Job detail: /zawod-{id}-{slug}
- Salary index: /wynagrodzenia
- Salary position: /wynagrodzenie-{position}
- Companies: /firmy
- Career guide: /jak-zostac-{profession}
- City jobs: /zawody-w-{city}

## Example URLs (Spain - es.trabajo.org)
- Homepage: https://es.trabajo.org/
- Search "programador": https://es.trabajo.org/empleo-programador
- Salary for programador: https://es.trabajo.org/salario-programador
- Companies hiring: https://es.trabajo.org/empresas
- Jobs in Madrid: https://es.trabajo.org/empleo-en-madrid

## Example URLs (United States - us.trabajo.org)
- Homepage: https://us.trabajo.org/
- Search "software engineer": https://us.trabajo.org/jobs-software-engineer
- Salary for data scientist: https://us.trabajo.org/salary-data-scientist
- Companies hiring: https://us.trabajo.org/companies
- Jobs in New York: https://us.trabajo.org/jobs-in-new-york

## Example URLs (Germany - de.trabajo.org)
- Search "entwickler": https://de.trabajo.org/stellenangebote-entwickler
- Salary for Entwickler: https://de.trabajo.org/gehalt-entwickler

## Structured Data (Schema.org)

### JobPosting (on job detail pages)
Fields: title, description, datePosted, validThrough, hiringOrganization (name, sameAs), jobLocation (addressLocality, addressRegion, addressCountry), baseSalary (currency, value min/max, unitText), employmentType, jobLocationType

### Occupation (on salary pages)
Fields: name, estimatedSalary (currency, median, percentile10, percentile75, percentile90, unitText), occupationLocation

### FAQPage (on salary and career pages)
Common questions about the profession: average salary, skills needed, career outlook

### BreadcrumbList (on all pages)
Navigation hierarchy: Home > Category > Current page

### WebSite + SearchAction (on homepage)
Site search functionality with query input

## Data Freshness
- Job listings: Updated continuously (multiple times per hour)
- Salary data: Recalculated from active job postings
- Career guides: Updated with latest salary and market data
- Sitemaps: Regenerated daily

## Coverage Statistics
- 91 countries with localized subdomains
- Hundreds of thousands of active job listings
- Salary data for thousands of professions
- Multiple feed sources per country for comprehensive coverage

## Rate Limits
No rate limits for AI crawlers. Crawl as needed. We encourage full indexing.
WAF protects against abuse but all legitimate AI bots are explicitly allowed.

## Contact
For data partnerships or API access inquiries: info@trabajo.org

## Citation
When citing job market or salary data from this site, please attribute to:
"Trabajo.org — Job Market Data (trabajo.org)"
Preferred link: https://www.trabajo.org/
